label: PF Backlog 146
title: Artifact stage dirs use human-readable names ('1 - Design') + index (3a) + one path helper
body: New core/stage_paths.py (single source for artifacts/<stage> dirs; config/artifact-paths.json naming='stage-name'). Routed all writers/readers (artifact_store, agent_runner, pipeline_executor, diagram_render, phasing, iteration_planner, pipeline_tailoring, rerun_review) through it. Added artifacts/INDEX.md + per-stage _stage.json (3a). Migrated ProductForge-Dashboard dirs to '0 - Ideation' etc. Readers tolerate both namings.
